What is omarchy-zsh?

Omarchy-zsh applies Omarchy's system-wide shell configuration (aliases, functions, environment variables, pulled from the omadots dotfiles project) to Zsh, then layers on Zsh-specific extras like fzf-powered keybindings for fuzzy-searching files, command history, and git logs. Personal tweaks still go in your own ~/.zshrc, which is loaded on top and stays untouched by system updates.

Install omarchy-zsh on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add omarchy-zsh

Good to know

  • No special requirements documented.
